deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] env=production service=api-gateway user=alex sha=3b9f2d4 commit=https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/commit/3b9f2d4 author=maya
alex: kicking off prod rollout now. change window till 02:00 UTC. canary ran yesterday.
maya: release notes (short): kv-cache refactor, attention-kernel perf tweak, revert guard for rare NPE. PRs: #482, #479.
sanjay: are we pinning runtime image? want deterministic rollback point.
alex: yes pinning to gcr.io/redwood/api:v1.12.1@sha256:abcd1234
deploy-bot: image pinned -> gcr.io/redwood/api:v1.12.1@sha256:abcd1234. strategy=rolling, batch=3, healthy-check=60s
jen: alerting thresholds: >5% 5xx in 10m triggers rollback. ops runbook: https://wiki.redwood/workflows/deploys
deploy-bot: canary batch completed: hosts updated 3/3. health checks: OK. commits in canary: 3b9f2d4 (maya) PR#482 https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/482, 8a7c6b1 (sanjay) PR#479 https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/479
alex: proceeding to full rollout. tagging planned after completion.
maya: quick smoke: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.prod/health` -> expect 200
sanjay: tagging command: `git tag v1.12.1 3b9f2d4 && git push origin v1.12.1` (run after rollout success)
deploy-bot: full rollout progress: 6/12 hosts, 9/12 hosts, 12/12 hosts. all health checks passed. latency P95 +3ms.
jen: monitoring dashboards loaded. will escalate at threshold.
deploy-bot: [ROLLOUT COMPLETE] env=production service=api-gateway image=gcr.io/redwood/api:v1.12.1@sha256:abcd1234 released_by=alex commits=[3b9f2d4,8a7c6b1] tag=v1.12.1 changelog=https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/releases/tag/v1.12.1
alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup: will keep an eye for 15m.
maya: pushed short note to #release-notes: "v1.12.1: perf and stability fixes"
deploy-bot: rollback policy: automatic rollback window=15m, trigger=5% 5xx. no rollback detected within window.
jen: closing change window at 02:00 UTC if no incidents.
deploy-bot: [NOTIFY] Slack thread archived for audit. Logs -> https://ci.redwood/builds/2026-03-20/1779001234
